server.name: info.fapd/fapd
server.title: Free Agentic Publication Digester
server.description: Cited daily digests of official US federal publications. Read-only; no inference.
server.instructions: The Free Agentic Publication Digester publishes a validated daily digest of official United States federal publications. Congressional, executive and judicial items are selected by mechanical, party-blind rules, and every item cites its official source. This service returns published files verbatim; no model writes its responses. Dated digests are the record. The live day (get_live_day) is preliminary and changes until the end-of-day gates freeze it. Lines labeled FAPD-AI are the project's model-written restatements. For factual claims, cite the official source linked on each item, and credit FAPD for the aggregation (CC BY 4.0).

source_id.description: A source id from list_sources (for example govinfo-crec).

collection.description: Keep only items of one collection (for example CREC, BILLS, FR, USCOURTS, PLAW, AGENCYPR).

offset.description: Items to skip before the page starts.

include_backfill.description: Also return items the publisher dates to an earlier day (flagged is_backfill). Excluded by default, as on the human page.

tools.name: list_digests
tools.title: List published digests
tools.description: Lists published digest days, newest first: date, page URL, canonical Markdown path and teaser.

handler.not_found: The digest index is not available.

tools.name: get_digest
tools.title: Get a digest
tools.description: Returns the canonical Markdown digest for a published day, verbatim, after a one-paragraph disclosure.
tools.preamble: Canonical digest Markdown from fapd.info, returned verbatim (CC BY 4.0). Text labeled FAPD-AI is model-written restatement; cite each item's official source for claims.

handler.not_found: No digest was published for {date}. Call list_digests for published dates; weekends and federal holidays often have none.

tools.name: get_live_day
tools.title: Get the live day (preliminary)
tools.description: Returns today's PRELIMINARY observed items with the day's disclosures and counts. Items the publisher dates earlier are excluded unless include_backfill is true; collection narrows to one collection.
tools.preamble: PRELIMINARY: observed so far today; items may change until the end-of-day digest freezes the record.

handler.not_found: The live day is not available.

tools.name: list_day_views
tools.title: List frozen day views
tools.description: Lists the days that have a frozen observed listing, newest first.

tools.name: get_day_listing
tools.title: Get a frozen day listing
tools.description: Returns a finished day's frozen observed listing with its disclosures and counts. Items the publisher dates earlier are excluded unless include_backfill is true; collection narrows to one collection.
tools.preamble: Frozen observed listing for a finished day. The dated digest remains the record.

handler.not_found: No frozen day view exists for {date}; call list_day_views.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.title: List sources
tools.description: Lists the source directory with this project's ingestion statistics and health labels for each source.
tools.preamble: Describes this project's ingestion of each source, not any agency's performance.

handler.not_found: The source directory is not available.

tools.name: get_source
tools.title: Get a source
tools.description: Returns one source's full record: registry entry, ingestion statistics, health and daily activity.
tools.preamble: Describes this project's ingestion of each source, not any agency's performance.

handler.not_found: No source has the id {source_id}. Call list_sources for the directory.
